notes: Eight distinct real original recordings. No existing source, nature-batch sound, synthetic substitute or same-source remix counted as an extra sound.
All exports are mono PCM16, native 44.1/48 kHz, 30-45 seconds, with 2-second equal-power tail/head overlap and rotated boundary; no whole-clip fade.
Short fan and bubbles originals are explicitly repeated; output duration does not equal unique recording duration.
Traffic alone is a partial original download: bytes 0-24999999 of 69610946, 86.805 decoded seconds available for source seconds 20-58. All other originals were completely downloaded.
Every HTTP Range request returned 206; for smaller originals the range covers the entire file and partialDownload is false.

Wooden-chime candidate https://freesound.org/people/Kinoton/sounds/376001/ requires login for original download and describes metal tones in a bamboo resonator, not bamboo clacking. Laundry is the permitted truthful substitute.
Bubbles are close-water studio bubbles in a mug, not a genuine deep-sea or hydrophone recording. Traffic distance is not established by the source.
Visible author/license text and page hashes are retained here; source HTML and original downloads remain only in OS temporary workspace, not app assets.
No listening or in-browser playback tests performed; no claim of absence of speech, seamless perceived cadence, or subjective sound quality.
No manifest, Dart, JavaScript, shared test, or nature-batch files modified; integration is left to the coordinating task.
